title: Writing a Linear Model
text: Translate the given information into $$2$$ linear models.

hintAnswer: Set the equations equal to each other.
title: Compare Models
text: To answer this problem, we need to find when our $$2$$ models intersect. What should I do if I want to find when (what amount of minutes) one model equals the other?
choices: Set the equations equal to each other.

title: Interpret
text: Interpret each model. Because the slope is larger in $$y=17, 000$$ + $$0.12x$$, the line is steeper and the slope in y=20,000+0.05 is less steep, but starts at 20,000 instead of 17,000. Therefore, $$y=17, 000$$ + $$0.12x$$ will be a higher pay option for a large enough $$x$$.

title: Interpret
text: So, when the lines intersect is when 17,000+0.12*x surpasses 20,000+0.05*x and is the larger income. $$x$$ is our answer (the value in jewelry we need to sell to produce a larger income).
